title: Gridline Frontend Protocol Consumer and Accessible Live States
released_boundary: GridlineFrontendProtocolConsumer: an accessible production frontend adapter and renderer that accepts typed desktop projections and emits typed user intents without implicit fixture fallback or backend-authority duplication.
consumer_purpose: A later integration lane can connect N1 hosting and O0 live transport to a frontend already capable of truthful runtime consumption.

w3c_wai_aria_tab_pattern.conclusion: Followed ARIA 1.2 Authoring Practices for Tabs: arrow keys navigate between tabs (roving tabindex), Home/End move to first/last, Enter/Space activate.

mdn_prefers_reduced_motion.conclusion: variables.css already honors prefers-reduced-motion; layout.css uses CSS custom properties for all transitions.

owasp_xss_prevention.conclusion: All untrusted projection string fields rendered via textContent or _escapeHtml-wrapped innerHTML. No eval() or new Function() in production path.

production_vs_fixture_behavior.unavailable_state_rendering: All 5 surfaces show 'unavailable' status in production when no projection received
production_vs_fixture_behavior.trust_state_provenance: All 6 TrustState values rendered: trusted_live, controlled_boundary, fixture, deferred, refused, corrupt

security_verification.no_unsafe_innerhtml_patterns: Verified - all innerHTML uses are pure literals, numeric scalars, or _escapeHtml-wrapped
security_verification.xss_payload_schema_validation: Projection fields with
security_verification.no_domain_authority_in_js: All intents carry authority: 'none_local'; backend owns policy

accessibility_verification.surface_tab_aria: All tabs have role='tab', aria-selected, keyboard nav via ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End/Enter
accessibility_verification.tabindex_roving: Active tab has tabindex=0; inactive have tabindex=-1
accessibility_verification.reduced_motion: variables.css honors prefers-reduced-motion; all transitions use CSS custom properties

deferred_seams: End-to-end browser integration test with real WebSocket
freeze_condition: Lane S1 freezes after this batch is published to origin/main and the pushed SHA is remotely verified. Reopening only for: defect inside the released boundary, named integration milestone consuming the GridlineFrontendProtocolConsumer, or user-directed architectural revision.

claim_adversary_results.authority_ownership: PASS - adapter does not implement domain authority
claim_adversary_results.production_boundary_realism: PASS - defaults to production mode, no silent fixture fallback
claim_adversary_results.crash_retry_duplicate_safety: PASS - projection patch sequence check prevents stale re-renders
claim_adversary_results.canonical_evidence_reconstruction: PASS - surface states deterministic from projection payloads
claim_adversary_results.lane_boundary_release_safety: PASS - only S1-owned frontend files modified
